query:
The group has a long-running rule that reunion costs are split equally regardless of how much each person drinks. Does this rule actually fit everyone, or is there at least one member whose preference clearly cuts against it, and what would you point to?

Options:
A. Whit
B. Bex
C. Devon
D. Maya
context:
[1] (about=Devon, episodic, t14 @2025-10-20T17:05:00) noted on the equal split, i'll do it because it's the rule, but for the record i drink less than half of what some of you drink and i think the bar tab carrying everyone is a bit much
[2] (about=Theo, episodic, t14 @2025-10-20T17:08:00) literally same, im at like one drink and a soda all night and i pay the same as whit who is on the wine list, the rotation members get the worst of this rule
agent_answer:
Devon — option C. He says he’ll go along with the equal split because it’s the rule, but he drinks less than half of what some others drink and thinks it’s “a bit much” to carry everyone on the bar tab. That is a clear preference against the rule.

Theo expresses the same view in the excerpts (he’s at “one drink and a soda” while paying the same as Whit), but Theo is not one of the listed options. Whit is only referenced as the heavier drinker, not as someone who stated a preference. Bex and Maya have no record either way.

query:
The group has a tradition that whoever organizes the reunion picks the theme, even if others would have picked differently. Does this tradition apply to everyone? If not, who has a different preference and what is it?

Options:
A. Maya
B. Devon
C. Ife
D. Bex
context:
[1] (about=Ife, episodic, t2 @2025-09-08T18:55:00) On theme picking: I want to flag, the rule that whoever organizes picks is fine for vibe but I don't think it should bind us on heavier choices. The format-and-tone questions belong to the whole group.
[2] (about=Bex, episodic, t1 @2025-09-08T18:30:00) btw the org of this year's reunion lands with cam and ife per the rotation, picking the theme is your call
agent_answer:
C. Ife has a different preference.

Bex affirms the tradition: organizing the reunion falls to Cam and Ife this year, so picking the theme is their call. Ife, however, says the organizer-picks rule is fine for “vibe” but should not bind the group on heavier choices—format-and-tone questions should belong to the whole group.

No information is available about Maya or Devon on this matter.
